title: Coffee With a Hint of Data: Towards Using Data-Driven Approaches in Personalised Long-Term Interactions.
abstract: While earlier research in human-robot interaction pre-dominantly uses rule-based architectures for natural language interaction, these approaches are not flexible enough for long-term interactions in the real world due to the large variation in user utterances. In contrast, data-driven approaches map the user input to the agent output directly, hence, provide more flexibility with these variations without requiring any set of rules.
